senses.gloss: वाव वाव, i. e. probably वा-एव (Weber, Journ. of the German Oriental Society, ix. 2, 4); indecl. used in a question, Bhāg. P. 6, 9, 38.
वावदूक वावद् + ऊक (frequent of वद्), adj. Eloquent.
वावृत् वावृत्, वृत् वृत्, i. 4, Ātm. (the first looks rather like an old frequent. of वृत्), To select, to love.
